title: Maple Leafs hire Jim Hiller as coach
content:
Jim Hiller has been named head coach of the Toronto Maple Leafs.

The 57-year-old most recently spent two seasons as head coach in Los Angeles, getting fired on March 1.

Prior to that, he had extensive experience as a NHL assistant coach, including a four-year stint with the Maple Leafs from 2015-2019.

Hiller’s hiring comes after an extensive search to replace Craig Berube.

Berube was fired on May 13 after a 28th-place finish by the Leafs.

This story will be updated.
